item.text: {"tool":"discover_evidence","argument":"Find sources on recognition of low-resolution single-staff music excerpts, constrained decoding to prevent repeated note generation, and chord-symbol recognition with editable kern export and consistent melody/chord transposition.","why":"Data and baselines are already inspected. Enlarged Audiveris has the best measured melody error rate on the pilot (0.6692), but misses 30 of 38 chords; greedy Transcoda produces 527 insertions. Sources can inform a small experiment targeting these distinct failures before spending the four-worker budget.","hypothesis":"Image preprocessing plus separate chord recognition, or constrained neural decoding, may address the observed failures more effectively than unrestricted greedy transcription.","expected_observation":"Relevant source IDs describing practical methods and their limitations, sufficient to select and read at least one source before assigning an experiment.","evidence_ids":["dataset","baseline"]}
